responsibilities.interaction: Inspect / Select cells and contextual one-shot spatial tools.
responsibilities.viewContext: Scope and Map Focus, with a conditional Inspect focused cell action.
responsibilities.interpretation: Layers and the Map key legend.

resultVisualization.legacyRFLabel: The previous RF category label was not itself actionable. It is replaced by the explicit Result visualization group name.

signal.availability: State remains explicit: unavailable, available, loading, ready, or error/retry.
signal.request: The existing lazy /api/coverage-surface fetch may occur when the user first loads the surface; it does not rerun RF analysis.

rays.meaning: Show or hide existing propagation rays.
rays.availability: Disabled until rays exist; checked state includes a check icon and aria-pressed.

radioQualityMetric.control: One native select labelled Radio-quality metric, shown only when interference data exists.
radioQualityMetric.unsupported: Selector stays absent without interference data; supported values remain exactly the existing analysis values.

viewContext.desktop: Scope and Map Focus are grouped inside the View disclosure; frequent Signal/Rays and supported metric controls remain directly available.
viewContext.phone: View opens one compact menu containing result visualization controls and view context in labelled sections; Layers stays a separate disclosure.

scope.label: Scope
scope.meaning: Filters existing ray display. The selected value is not Network cluster membership.

mapFocus.label: Map Focus
mapFocus.meaning: Visualization emphasis and selected-ray reference; does not inspect or change cluster membership.
mapFocus.inspectAction: Inspect focused cell is available only when a focused Cell exists and differs from the Cell already being inspected. Changing Map Focus never inspects automatically.

layers.control: Separate Map layers disclosure, adjacent to View.

legend.label: Map key
legend.role: Named region containing a native disclosure button and conditionally hidden contents.
legend.preserves: Existing signal/ray meaning, result source/freshness, metric thresholds, and exact sample ranges.

noScientificChanges: No RF quantity, formula, threshold, ray calculation, interference value, or unsupported-state semantics were changed.
